subject: Committed spend release automation & entity-level VAT routing
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Committed spend release automation & entity-level VAT routing

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to put a lightweight, auditable process around the annual committed spend you signed (BL-2027-07) so that drawdowns are triggered automatically when usage thresholds are met and invoices are issued from the correct Redwood legal entity to match BrightLane's VAT routing needs.

Proposed high-level plan:
- Define threshold bands (e.g., 25%, 50%, 75%, final) that trigger invoice creation and ledger draws
- Automate invoice generation + PDF delivery to procurement@brightlane.com and the assigned AP contact
- Route invoicing entity based on country-of-consumption + your VAT certificate mapping (we'll accept the certificates per entity)
- Provide a 30-day window for dispute before funds are pulled from the prepay balance

Ask from your side before we build the automation:
1) Confirm the legal entities BrightLane wants invoices from and provide the VAT certificate for each (attached would be ideal)
2) Share the PO number you want printed on invoices and any special remit instructions
3) Confirm the AP contact who will receive PDF invoices and who to copy for ledger reconciliation

I've attached a short spec (commitment_release_spec.xlsx) that describes the webhook/HUBS events we'll emit and the fields you should expect. If you can upload the PO and VAT certs, we'll start mapping entities and propose the automation timeline.

Target timeline: mapping + small pilot internal test in 2 weeks, production automation by month-end if PO + VAT certs are in place.

Thanks — I'll loop Kim and Jonas for ops and tax mapping.

Best,

Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: commitment_release_spec.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlane.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlane.com>, Anders Lykke <anders.lykke@brightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 16:38:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Committed spend release automation & entity-level VAT routing

Hi Markus —

Appreciate the clarity. We're comfortable with the threshold bands you suggested; one ask from our side is that the 75% band sends an advance notification 7 days before the drawdown (email + webhook) so our treasury can approve any cross-entity routing changes.

I've attached: BrightLane_PO_2027-01.pdf (signed PO) and BrightLane_VAT_CERT.jpg (EU entity). Procurement will confirm the legal entity list by tomorrow EOB. AP remit: ap-team@brightlane.com. Please include PO# BL-PO-2027-01 on all invoices.

Two clarifications:
- Can you confirm which Redwood entity will invoice for UK consumption vs. EU consumption? We need the VAT registration numbers to match our intercompany routing.
- For the dispute window, 30 days is fine, but can we have a short hold policy for invoices >€250k where the funds are not auto-deducted until manual approval?

Thanks — looping Anders to confirm the entity roster.

Best,

Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance, BrightLane Analytics
elena.ruiz@brightlane.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: BrightLane_PO_2027-01.pdf (application/pdf), BrightLane_VAT_CERT.jpg (image/jpeg)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlane.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, LegalBilling <legal-billing@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Committed spend release automation & entity-level VAT routing

Thanks Elena — this is helpful. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Entity routing: Redwood will default to invoicing from Redwood Inference Ltd (EU entity) for EU consumption and Redwood Inference UK Ltd for UK consumption. Jonas will follow up with exact VAT numbers and entity codes by EOD tomorrow.

2) Hold policy: we can implement an exception rule for invoices > €250k requiring manual approval from Sunny (LegalBilling). We'll surface these as flags in the webhook payload and pause auto-draw until approved.

3) PO and AP remit received — we'll print PO# BL-PO-2027-01 on invoices and send PDFs to ap-team@brightlane.com + procurement@brightlane.com.

Implementation plan:
- Today: Jonas maps entity IDs to your VAT cert and updates the spec (we'll add fields: invoice_entity_code, vat_number, hold_flag)
- 48 hours: internal pilot where we simulate the 25% and 50% draws (no money movement) and deliver the invoice PDFs to your AP mailbox
- After pilot: production toggle and auto-draw activation with the 7-day pre-notification webhook

Can you confirm who should be listed as the approver for >€250k holds (name + email)? We'll add them to the approval workflow.

Looping Jonas to own the entity mapping.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0132
